office_does: Chelan PUD's five commissioners set policy, approve budgets and expenditures, and set electric rates and charges; at-large District B is elected by all Chelan County voters.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Kelly Allen, elected unopposed in 2022 and board president as of May 2026, is the only candidate for a four-year term.

candidates.summary: Chelan PUD commissioner for at-large District B since January 2023 and board president as of May 2026; a Chelan insurance-agency owner and former Chelan City Council member. The only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Elected unopposed in 2022 to the seat Dennis Bolz held for 16 years [S4][S5][S6]
Owns the Kelly Allen Agency, an insurance agency in Chelan [S3]
